title: 18265 - 18265/P1857/006231
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Fault Code(s) stored in Engine Control Unit (ECU)
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Engine Control Unit for Fault Code(s)
